card.text: Explore Transvaalia in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Coarse lightcurve reconstruction, with an approximate size from infrared observations. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermal diameter 25.458 ± 0.591 km; quoted fit error excludes about 20% systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects. This coarse convex model has uncertain shape and pole; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 12.729 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
